options.name: Conversion Inquisition
options.benefit: Use Wisdom instead of Charisma for Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate and gain a conversion power.

options.name: Heresy Inquisition
options.benefit: Become exceptionally skilled at exposing lies and resisting hostile divine magic.

options.name: Imprisonment Inquisition
options.benefit: Gain powers for binding, restraining, and tracking prisoners.

options.name: Justice Inquisition
options.benefit: Gain a scaling attack bonus against a creature that harmed you or an ally.

options.name: Persistence Inquisition
options.benefit: Gain relentless footing, rerolls, and resistance to debilitating effects.

options.name: Tactics Inquisition
options.benefit: Improve initiative and reposition yourself and allies tactically.

options.name: Torture Inquisition
options.benefit: Use pain to improve Intimidate and impair resistant foes.

options.name: Valor Inquisition
options.benefit: Bolster courage and punish creatures that use fear.

options.name: Zeal Inquisition
options.benefit: Act quickly and deliver zealous attacks against designated foes.
